18/S0.subgoal: Recap the previous lecture's content and provide an overview of the tracking technologies to be discussed in the current lecture.

18/S1.subgoal: Describe the two types of electromechanical trackers: world-fixed and wearable.

18/S2.subgoal: Explain electromagnetic trackers and how they use magnetic fields and currents for position measurement.

18/S3.subgoal: Explain acoustic tracking and the categories of vision-based tracking.

18/S4.subgoal: Describe infrared vision-based tracking, including outside-in and inside-out configurations.

18/S5.subgoal: Explain the three types of visible light-based tracking: fiducial, natural feature, and model-based.

18/S6.subgoal: Describe 3D structure tracking using depth sensors to create and track models.

18/S7.subgoal: Describe inertial and GPS tracking systems and their applications.

18/S8.subgoal: Describe motion capture, eye tracking, and hybrid tracking systems.

18/S9.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture and provide references.
